concept_stage.prompt: A text-free, physical architecture metaphor for a universal personal workspace connecting to multiple separate group work lanes: one calm private desk rail enters a precision mechanical approval gate, then branches into several identical shared rails. Matte zinc charcoal, brushed steel and warm paper material, muted steel-blue private stream, one tiny burnt-orange decision marker, orthographic technical editorial composition, no panels, no screens, no interfaces, no logos, no letters, no words, no numbers, no glow.

implementation_stage.target_format: Native-text architecture document with private-to-group publication gate
